newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global unit to buy retail dealer.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global unit to buy retail dealer.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Wednesday its retail and wholesale business unit, IMC AgriBusiness Inc, signed a letter of intent to acquire the fertilizer assets of Hutson's AG Services and Hutson Co Inc.
Hutson's AG Services and Hutson Co form a Midwestern retail farm center and storage terminal company with annual revenues of about $100 million. Terms of the pending acquisition were not disclosed.

The two privately owned businesses are based in Murray, Ky. Hutson's AG Services consists of 14 retail farm centers in Illinois, Kentucky and Tennessee. Hutson Co includes seven dry and liquid terminals in Illinois, Indiana and Kentucky with a combined storage capacity of about 250,000 tons of crop nutrient products.

The proposed acquisition would increase the number of IMC AgriBusiness retail farm centers to about 240. In addition, IMC AgriBusiness would operate a total of 14 terminals with a combined storage capacity of about 600,000 tons of liquid and dry product.
The transaction is targeted to close by early May.
IMC Global produces and markets phosphates and potash crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients. It also distributes crop nutrients through its Farmarket and Rainbow distribution networks.
